title: [finding] dead tracker citations outside `packages/spec/src` have no carrier: #20234 sweeps only the spec tree, and PR #20554 makes 26 more visible (`pre-#N` / `Pre-#N`) in cli, drivers, metadata, objectql, plugins, runtime and types
body:
Filing gate: **① a family with a named population and a carrier gap**. Finding class **(a)**: shipped source cites a tracker number that answers 404. That is the rot ruling C+D on #19123 (`5749154545`, maintainer 「同意」) set out to remove. `reach:` source comments in published packages; the blocking diff verdict judges only citations a PR adds, so the existing sites are never flagged.

Filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat 2 (`session_014EJ1ED8X4MMrT18BhVx4tx`, seat post #18549) from the #20330 dev report `5882580588` (out-of-scope finding 3, "the seat names the family closure card"). ⛔ Filed bare: routing, grading and whether this is one card or a per-domain split belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The carrier gap

- #20234 (the staged sweep carrying ruling C+D) is scoped by its title and filing to `packages/spec/src`. Stages 1–4 cover `kernel/`, `contracts/`, `api/` and `data/`.
- PR #20226's census, the only measurement of the scale, was bounded to `packages/spec/src/**` too.
- Nothing carries the same rot in the other packages.

## Population, measured

- **Whole-tree census:** `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs --census --json`, as the #20330 dev ran it. At `a3c14755f8` (184 pages, frontier #20551) it reports **2,532 dead sites across the tree**; at base `288611e3e5` it was 2,509. The census does not split by package in its summary. The split is the next taker's first measurement.
- **Newly visible once PR #20554 lands:** 26 sites spelled `pre-#N` / `Pre-#N`, which the gate used to class as cross-repo and never judge. All answer 404:
  - cli: `generate.ts:1842` #14657, `storage-driver.ts:206` #6345
  - driver-sql: `schema-drift.ts:2458`, `:2474` #12998; `sql-driver.ts:3872`, `:16545` #17590; `sql-driver.ts:18285`, `:18324` #12998; `sql-driver.ts:20095` #12380
  - driver-turso: `remote-transport.ts:2624` #12380
  - lint: `validate-searchable-fields.ts:312` #8404
  - metadata-protocol: `protocol.ts:2793` #10888, `seed-loader.ts:1947` #11674
  - objectql: `action-governance.ts:339` #14423
  - plugin-auth: `auth-manager.ts:5629` #14762
  - plugin-security: `bootstrap-platform-admin.ts:266`, `:630` and `per-organization-catalog.ts:314` #8692, `permission-set-projection.ts:482` #6483
  - plugin-sharing: `backfill-sys-record-share-organizations.ts:5` #14484
  - runtime: `domains/mcp.ts:364` #8726, `sandbox/body-runner.ts:548`, `:735` and `script-runner.ts:440` #14758
  - types: `driver-error-classification.ts:608` #13324, `node.ts:1428` #10943
- **The pair case:** 4 more sites outside the spec tree, `objectui#6110 + #6111`, whose second number resolves nowhere here: `metadata-core` `form-predicate-root-policy.ts:14`, `:120`, `:205` and `metadata` `plugin.ts:910`. The remedy is to qualify each number, which PR #20554's refusal text now states.
- Two dead sites that are inside `packages/spec/src/**` are #20234's and are recorded there: `meta-spelling/manifest-collection-spelling.ts:71` `pre-#10194` and `ui/view.zod.ts:3634`'s `#6111`.

## Suggested shape (⛔ not a ruling)

The same method as #20234: ruling C+D form C, one PR per area, and a census with lit and dead controls, rewriting nothing a PR in flight holds. The `domain:*` of each area follows the package, so triage may split this per domain or keep one staged card.

Dedupe: a REST listing of the 1,000 most recently updated issues and PRs (down to #19803), grepped locally for `dead tracker`, `deleted tracker`, `dead citation` and `cite … dead`. It found #20234 (spec/src only), its stage PRs #20326, #20342 and #20533, PR #20226 (spec-bounded census) and #17698 (two specific numbers, closed). None carries the packages outside the spec tree.
